goal: Preserve sync ownership, progress and file boundaries

invariants.text: Deleting the last local file removes the remote copy
Imported copies do not become another machine's source
Each server, project and receiver has its own cursor
A tombstone preserves another machine's active copy
An identical retry repairs a failed materialization
Worktree source files stay outside sync
Sync does not write through symlinks

constraints.text: Run exactly seven declared mutations in disposable copies with per-run timeouts

non_goals.text: Do not change production sync data or claim coverage for undeclared defects

acceptance_checks.description: All seven regression scenarios pass without mutations
Each mutation fails its intended invariant assertion
